name: Despill
description: Removes green or blue spill from the edges of a keyed subject.

params.name: mix
params.description: Spillmap mix: how much of red is compared with the screen color

params.name: expand
params.description: Spillmap expand: how much of the other channel is ignored

params.name: red
params.description: Red scale applied to the spill

params.name: green
params.description: Green scale applied to the spill

params.name: blue
params.description: Blue scale applied to the spill

params.name: brightness
params.description: Brightness added back where the spill was

params.name: alpha
params.description: Write the spillmap into alpha (1 - spill)
